reuse.why: The new action reuses category selection, amount conversion, sheet access, batching and undo wrappers, although setZero duplicates the category-loading query.

duplication.why: setZero and getAverageCategories now contain identical category, group and notes queries with matching result-type declarations.

placement.why: Eligibility rules remain in fill-categories.ts, database access and orchestration remain in actions.ts, and handler registration remains in app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared eligibility rules, registration, testing and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared eligibility and amount conversion keep the design straightforward, with duplicated category loading and the increasingly narrow getAverageCategories name as minor maintenance concerns.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions continue through shouldFillCategory, and setLastMonthSpending uses averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated category-loading query in setZero and getAverageCategories is explicit rather than renamed or reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getAverageCategories gains includeHiddenCategories, and shouldFillCategory gains saved-template and fixed-group exclusion branches; all consumers retain shared eligibility checks.
